data.name: Logistics Orchestrator Agent
data.description: Plans and executes an end-to-end shipment: picks a carrier, issues the waybill and reports progress.

skills.name: Plan a shipment
skills.description: Chooses a carrier and service level from origin, destination, weight and deadline.
examples: Ship a 2 kg parcel from Lviv to Kyiv by tomorrow

skills.name: Dispatch a shipment
skills.description: Issues the waybill through the shipping MCP server and returns the tracking number.

skills.name: Report shipment status
skills.description: Summarises where a parcel is and when it is expected to arrive.
